constraints: After the last sibling is reached, the system variable OK is set to 0.

overloadMerges.note: siblingElemName and siblingElemValue are filled/returned params (docs: '<-' direction); autoparse defaults all params to direction:in. Also adds jointConstraint reflecting the doc syntax's nested optional (siblingElemValue can only be passed together with siblingElemName).

params.name: siblingElemName
params.description: Receives the name of the next sibling element

params.name: siblingElemValue
params.description: Receives the value of the next sibling element

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Navigates to the next sibling of an XML element, returning its reference and optionally its name and value; sets OK to 0 after the last sibling.

jointConstraints.rule: siblingElemValue can only be passed if siblingElemName is also passed (the syntax nests siblingElemValue inside siblingElemName's optional group).
